item.title: Tylenol: Does it Cause ADHD and Autism, or Is it Safe During Pregnancy?
item.description: Headaches in pregnancy are a common prenatal problem and there are effective, safe alternatives to tylenol and other medications.

item.title: Holding On and Letting Go: Modern Friendship in Women’s Lives
item.description: Explore the importance of friendship in our lives and learn how to nurture meaningful connections with Anna Goldfarb.

item.title: Have You Been Medically Hexed? The Power of Words to Heal and to Harm
item.description: The nocebo and placebo effect - their impact on health decisions. Can negative & positive words from your provider influence outcomes?

item.title: Breastfeeding Challenges, Tongue Tie, & Trusting Your Instincts
item.description: Listen in to this important conversation as we explore the joys and challenges of breastfeeding, and offer lots of actionable insights.

item.title: Normalize It: From Miscarriage to Midlife—Owning Our Stories Without Shame with Jessica Zucker
item.description: Explore the deep impact of shame as we uncover silent struggles in women's health and stories that need to be shared.

item.title: Perinatal Mood and Anxiety Disorders (PMADS): The Hidden Motherhood Struggle
item.description: PMADS is the #1 birth complication and the #2 cause of maternal mortality. In this episode we unpack perinatal mood and anxiety disorders.

item.title: Reclaiming Postpartum: A New (Old) Model of Mama + Baby Care
item.description: Eva Zasloff & I talk about why reimagining postpartum care is crucial for nurturing mothers and their babies during the early weeks together.

item.title: The High Cost of ‘I’m Fine’: The Truth About High-Functioning Anxiety and Invisible Depression
item.description: Join me and Helen Marie where we explore how high-functioning anxiety and invisible depression in women are often signs of a deeper story.

item.title: Microplastics and Nanoplastics: How Alarmed Should We Be?
item.description: Examine the risks of microplastics and nanoplastics in our environment and their implications for reproductive health and safety.

item.title: Antidepressants During Pregnancy: What’s a Mom to Do?
item.description: None of us wants to have to take an antidepressants during pregnancy. But untreated depression in pregnancy can be harmful.
